STEP 1 - Scene: plated meal, breaded/crumbed fish or chicken pieces with mixed salad leaves, cherry tomato, olive.

STEP 2 - Vessel: white square plate ~26 cm side; treat as round dinner plate 26 cm diameter.
Area = 3.14 x (13)^2 = 531 cm^2

STEP 3 - Items:
- breaded fried fish/chicken pieces (3 pieces)
- red pepper/tomato bits and herb garnish on fish
- mixed salad leaves (frisée, spinach-type greens)
- cherry tomato half
- olive
- nuts/seeds scattered

STEP 4 - Area:
- breaded pieces 14% = 74 cm^2
- salad leaves 12% = 64 cm^2
- garnish/pepper/herb on fish 3% = 16 cm^2
- tomato 1% = 5 cm^2
- olive and nuts 1% = 5 cm^2
- Total covered 31% = 164 cm^2 (check: 14+12+3+1+1 = 31)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- breaded pieces 74 cm^2 x 1.5 cm = 111 ml
- salad leaves 64 cm^2 x 3 cm = 192 ml
- garnish 16 cm^2 x 0.5 cm = 8 ml
- tomato 5 cm^2 x 2 cm = 10 ml
- olive/nuts 5 cm^2 x 1 cm = 5 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- breaded pieces 111 ml x 0.9 = 100 g
- salad leaves 192 ml x 0.15 = 29 g
- garnish 8 ml x 0.6 = 5 g
- tomato 10 ml x 0.6 = 6 g
- olive/nuts 5 ml x 0.6 = 3 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- breaded pieces 100 g x 230 kcal/100g = 230 kcal
- salad leaves 29 g x 20 kcal/100g = 6 kcal
- garnish 5 g x 40 kcal/100g = 2 kcal
- tomato 6 g x 18 kcal/100g = 1 kcal
- olive/nuts 3 g x 150 kcal/100g = 5 kcal
- Total 143 g, 244 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: about a third of the plate is covered with three breaded pieces and a small salad, so ~140 g and ~250 kcal is plausible.
